title: Kelley W NDE 883
content:
1st: Dentist OD'd me on nitrous oxide. ‘I first saw a purple skeleton, at the top of the room, sitting on a stool, with cowboy hat on, and strumming guitar, singing 'The Guitar Man' by Bread.’ It was amusing until I suddenly was up where he had been, alone, and watching the Dentist freak out trying to revive me. Before I knew anything else, I was back in my body. 2nd: I had a very high temperature and massive pelvic infection and was later told I was talking to ‘leprechauns’ before I ‘died’. That I do not recall. What I do recall, and can still recall, was finding myself in the blackest black, cold void, with a crushing feeling of being utterly alone, despair and loss. (It was not at all what I expected it to be as I was one of those little kids who grew up talking about ‘living before’ and had a very unorthodox view of religion from the earliest age.) There was no sense of anyone else being there, no light, vast nothingness and terrible. It seemed a short while, yet an eternity. I was physically taken up by a neighbor and taken to the hospital. The jostling revived me, as I was suddenly very happy to be back in my body & in pain. 3rd: This is all very vivid, even after all these years. I had gone out to the ranch to help lead a large group of people on a trail ride. It was a long day. We got home and I had a terrible need, a command really, to return. I bathed and put on clean clothes. I had to talk to my husband into going back. It was nearly 9pm. I told him I had to go, though I did not wish to. Of course, I know it was my destiny. We went back and a chain of events led me to giving a tour of our African lion prides. I was compelled into an area I never went and was attacked by a lioness that pulled me through a fence up to my shoulder. Everything went into slow motion during the attack and I ‘split in two’ in that one part of me was conscious, the other was like a separate being, spiritual, but I knew it was my soul. After I was freed from the cage, I lost my ability to see anyone, just grey shadows on a sort of movie screen in front of me. People's feelings and fear (there were perhaps 20 to 30 people there) were palpable, and threatened to carry me away like a tide, if I gave into it. To the right, on that screen, was coolness and peace. To the left the panic and pain of those around me. One half of me kept telling those around how to treat me (I'm a former EMT & I recognized my voice) the other was fighting the desire to turn toward the right as I believed that if I succumbed, the ranch would be in a lot of trouble and perhaps even sold. I sensed children there, their ‘shadows’ were more golden and I was ordering people to get them away from the spectacle. The ambulance finally arrived. I was still in this double state, telling them what to do, yet seeing nothing but those grey shadows and the emotions of everyone around. Then they said they could handle it and I thought I could then relax and as I did, I was sucked out of my body, tiny enough to still be in the ambulance and finally I could see like normal again. I saw an EMT pounding on my chest, slapping my face, etc., & my brother-in-law in the front seat turn and gawk, and the shock on my husband's face. The ambulance was bouncing over dirt roads at high speeds and I thought ‘where are we?’ and was instantly above the ambulance seeing and recognizing how far from the city we still were. I recall thinking ‘Well, I'm dead, they can't get there in time.’ When I was sucked back into my body being slammed around on the gurney in that cramped ambulance. We got to hospital and there were no doctors around so it was again up to me to ‘hold on’. 4 hours later a surgeon arrived and I was taken into surgery. Just as I was wheeling past my brother-in-law, I heard him say the same lion had attacked a little girl earlier that day. I gave in then, thinking all was lost. 4th: I ‘died’ during surgery, was revived and in a coma for almost 2 weeks as they could not stabilize my blood pressure. I remember it so very clearly! The surgery death I saw the operating room and the surgeons but before I could think much more about it, I was swooshed into a place with 4 robed beings. No wings. There was Ethereal, beautiful, whiteness everywhere. They spoke without speaking. Like a chorus: ‘Suicide is wrong:’ ‘Love is all that matters:’ ‘Shun those who have killed themselves’ Over and over. I was aware of others there in this timeless space, but they were not the focus. It seemed I was there a very long time. Now what no one on earth knew at the time: I was heavily into Sylvia Plath at the time, hated my father-in-law with a passion and was in fact suicidal, and had been trying to figure out a way to do it without it being obvious what it was. I was then taken to another place, like the most colorful park imaginable and allowed to see my most beloved grandfather - the only real love I had ever known - and ‘they’ let him stay with me during the entire coma period. It was splendid! When I finally came to normal consciousness, my first remark was that grandfather had been with me the whole time. As the days passed and my husband’s family members were treating me like a loon or something, I started looking for earthly answers. I started asking if ANY man had been there that whole time. The answer was no, not even my husband or other family members, at least not for more than a few minutes at a time, and they did not talk to me even then.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: 1st NDE: was suddenly up near the ceiling/top of the room watching the dentist try to revive her. 3rd NDE: was 'tiny enough to still be in the ambulance' and could see; then was instantly above the ambulance.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described being 'sucked out of my body' and later 'sucked back into my body' and 'slammed around on the gurney'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: 2nd NDE: 'blackest black, cold void' with crushing loneliness; no light.

arrival.other_being_detail: 4 robed beings (no wings) in ethereal whiteness; later saw beloved grandfather who stayed with her during coma.

environment.environment_other_detail: 4th NDE: 'Ethereal, beautiful, whiteness everywhere.' Later: 'most colorful park imaginable.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: 1st: 'Before I knew anything else, I was back in my body.' 2nd: revived by jostling during transport. 3rd: 'sucked back into my body' in ambulance. 4th: revived after surgery; later regained consciousness after coma.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple events: 1) nitrous oxide overdose at dentist; 2) high fever/massive pelvic infection; 3) lion attack; 4) died during surgery with coma afterward.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard imagery/phenomena: purple skeleton with cowboy hat playing guitar; 'split in two' (dual consciousness); perception of people as grey shadows and emotions as a tide; robed beings repeating moral statements.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Multiple separate NDEs with differing patterns: (1) immediate OBE and return; (2) void with despair and return; (3) dual-state then OBE in ambulance then return; (4) OBE in OR then encounter with robed beings, then colorful park with grandfather during coma, then return to consciousness.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: OBE/return themes recur across multiple episodes; multiple NDE events reported (1974, 1980, 1986).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: 3rd event: simultaneous dual awareness ('split in two')—one part directing care verbally while the other experienced a spiritual pull toward peace.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Purple skeleton in cowboy hat strumming guitar and singing 'The Guitar Man'; reported being told she talked to 'leprechauns' (not recalled); 'split in two' dual consciousness; perception of people as grey/golden 'shadows' with emotions as a tide; four robed beings repeating: 'Suicide is wrong', 'Love is all that matters', 'Shun those who have killed themselves'; grandfather 'stayed with me during the entire coma period.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I first saw a purple skeleton, at the top of the room, sitting on a stool, with cowboy hat on, and strumming guitar, singing 'The Guitar Man' by Bread.” “finding myself in the blackest black, cold void, with a crushing feeling of being utterly alone, despair and loss.” “Everything went into slow motion during the attack and I ‘split in two’…” “I was sucked out of my body…” “Suicide is wrong:” “Love is all that matters:” “Shun those who have killed themselves”
